videos.title: States of matter for children
videos.descripcion: Introduces the states of matter with clear, simple examples for children.

videos.title: The states of water
videos.descripcion: Explains the three states of water (solid, liquid, and gas) and their state changes.

questions.q: At what temperature does water boil at sea level?
questions.explanation: Under normal conditions, water boils at 100 °C.

questions.q: What is the change from solid to liquid called?
questions.explanation: Ice melts when it turns into liquid water.

questions.q: What state is water in inside clouds?
questions.explanation: Water vapor (gaseous state) forms clouds.

videos.title: PHOTOSYNTHESIS | Educational videos for children
videos.descripcion: Describes the process of photosynthesis, the importance of chlorophyll, and sunlight.

videos.title: Photosynthesis in plants
videos.descripcion: Illustrates in a fun way how plants make their own food.

questions.q: What gas do plants produce during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants release oxygen as a byproduct of photosynthesis.

questions.q: What do plants need to carry out photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis requires sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide.

questions.q: In which part of the plant does photosynthesis mainly occur?
questions.explanation: Leaves contain chlorophyll, where photosynthesis takes place.

videos.title: The food chain | Educational videos for children
videos.descripcion: Simply explains what a food chain is and who makes it up.

videos.title: What is the food chain?
videos.descripcion: Defines the roles of producers, consumers, and decomposers in the food chain.

questions.q: What is the first link in the food chain?
questions.explanation: Producers (plants) are the base of every food chain.

questions.q: What are herbivores?
questions.explanation: Herbivores feed exclusively on plants.

questions.q: What is the function of decomposers?
questions.explanation: Decomposers return nutrients to the soil.

videos.title: The solar system | Educational videos for children
videos.descripcion: A journey through the 8 planets of our solar system, explaining their orbits around the Sun.

videos.title: The solar system for children
videos.descripcion: A space adventure to learn about the planets and the Sun.

questions.q: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the planet closest to our star.

questions.q: How many planets are there in our solar system?
questions.explanation: There are currently 8 recognized planets in the solar system.

questions.q: Which is the largest planet?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the giant planet of our solar system.

videos.title: MAGNETISM for children: what are magnets?
videos.descripcion: Introduces the concept of magnetism, magnetic poles, and attraction and repulsion.

videos.title: ELECTROMAGNETISM for children
videos.descripcion: Explains what an electromagnet is and how it works.

questions.q: Which of these materials is magnetic?
questions.explanation: Iron is a ferromagnetic material that is attracted to magnets.

questions.q: What are the ends of a magnet called?
questions.explanation: Magnets have a north pole and a south pole.

questions.q: What happens when you bring two like poles together?
questions.explanation: Like poles repel; opposite poles attract.

videos.title: The circulatory system of the human body for children
videos.descripcion: A tour of the circulatory system to understand how blood travels through the body.

videos.title: THE HUMAN HEART | Educational videos for children
videos.descripcion: Shows the anatomy of the heart and how blood circulation works.

videos.title: THE CIRCULATORY SYSTEM
videos.descripcion: Explains the circulatory system, its parts, and functions.

questions.q: How many chambers does the human heart have?
questions.explanation: The heart has four chambers: two atria and two ventricles.

questions.q: What does blood transport throughout the body?
questions.explanation: Blood carries oxygen and nutrients to all cells.

questions.q: What is the main function of the heart?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood through the circulatory system.

videos.title: The respiratory system of the human body for children
videos.descripcion: Describes how the lungs work and gas exchange during breathing.

videos.title: THE RESPIRATORY SYSTEM
videos.descripcion: A brief, clear explanation of the respiratory system.

videos.title: BREATHING: the RESPIRATORY SYSTEM
videos.descripcion: Explains the breathing process and the parts of the respiratory system.

questions.q: What gas do we take from the air when we breathe?
questions.explanation: When we inhale, our lungs take oxygen from the air.

questions.q: Where does gas exchange take place?
questions.explanation: The pulmonary alveoli are where O₂ and CO₂ are exchanged.

questions.q: What do we expel when we exhale?
questions.explanation: When we exhale, we remove the CO₂ produced by cells.

videos.title: The digestive system of the human body for children
videos.descripcion: A journey through the digestive system to understand the digestion process.

videos.title: The digestive system and digestion
videos.descripcion: Explains how the digestive system works and the digestion process.

videos.title: The digestive system: what is digestion?
videos.descripcion: Answers the question of what digestion is and how it takes place.

questions.q: Where does digestion begin?
questions.explanation: Digestion begins in the mouth with chewing and saliva.

questions.q: What is the function of the stomach?
questions.explanation: The stomach produces acids that break down food.

questions.q: Where are nutrients mainly absorbed?
questions.explanation: The small intestine is where most nutrients are absorbed.

videos.title: WHAT IS DENSITY? easy and simple with examples
videos.descripcion: Defines the concept of density in an easy way with practical examples.

videos.title: MATERIALS AND THEIR PROPERTIES
videos.descripcion: Explores the properties of materials, including density, with experiments.

videos.title: DENSITY || WHAT IS IT? || SCIENCE FOR CHILDREN
videos.descripcion: Explains what density is with visual experiments for children.

questions.q: Why does ice float on water?
questions.explanation: Ice is less dense than liquid water, so it floats.

questions.q: Which material is denser?
questions.explanation: Iron has a higher density than wood and cork.

questions.q: How is density calculated?
questions.explanation: Density = Mass divided by Volume (D = m/V).

videos.title: STATIC ELECTRICITY | Draw My Life
videos.descripcion: Visually and entertainingly explains what static electricity is.

videos.title: Electricity
videos.descripcion: Introduces the world of electricity, including electric charges.

videos.title: ELECTRICITY for children ⚡ Static and dynamic electricity
videos.descripcion: Differentiates between static and dynamic electricity, and shows simple experiments.

questions.q: What happens when you rub a balloon on your hair?
questions.explanation: Rubbing generates static electricity on the balloon.

questions.q: What type of charges attract each other?
questions.explanation: Opposite charges (+ and -) attract each other.

questions.q: What is a good conductor of electricity?
questions.explanation: Metals are excellent electrical conductors.

videos.title: TERRESTRIAL ECOSYSTEMS for CHILDREN
videos.descripcion: A clear, concise explanation of terrestrial ecosystems for primary school.

videos.title: What are ecosystems? - Types of ecosystems for children
videos.descripcion: Presents different types of ecosystems, including terrestrial ones, and their biodiversity.

videos.title: Terrestrial ecosystem
videos.descripcion: Focuses on terrestrial ecosystems and their characteristics.

questions.q: What is an ecosystem?
questions.explanation: An ecosystem includes all living things and their physical environment.

questions.q: Which is the most biodiverse ecosystem?
questions.explanation: Tropical rainforests host the greatest diversity of species.

questions.q: What factors make up the abiotic environment?
questions.explanation: The abiotic environment includes water, soil, temperature, and climate.

videos.title: What is an earthquake?
videos.descripcion: Explains tectonic plates and why earthquakes occur.

videos.title: What is a volcano?
videos.descripcion: Describes what volcanoes are, magma, and eruptions.

videos.title: Why do earthquakes happen?
videos.descripcion: A detailed explanation of the causes of earthquakes.

questions.q: What is molten rock inside a volcano called?
questions.explanation: Magma is molten rock underground; lava is when it comes out.

questions.q: What causes earthquakes?
questions.explanation: Earthquakes are caused by the movement of tectonic plates.

questions.q: Where do most volcanoes form?
questions.explanation: Volcanoes form mainly at plate boundaries.

videos.title: The Sun | Educational videos for children
videos.descripcion: Talks about solar radiation and the importance of the Sun as an energy source.

videos.title: What is energy? - Types of energy for children
videos.descripcion: Explains different types of energy, highlighting renewable sources such as solar.

videos.title: Types of energy
videos.descripcion: Presents different types of energy, with a focus on renewable sources.

questions.q: How does the Sun's energy reach Earth?
questions.explanation: Solar energy travels as electromagnetic radiation.

questions.q: What is a renewable energy source?
questions.explanation: Solar energy is renewable because the Sun does not run out.

questions.q: What do plants use solar energy for?
questions.explanation: Plants use solar energy to carry out photosynthesis.

videos.title: The water cycle for children
videos.descripcion: Answers questions about the water cycle and the origin of rain.

videos.title: The water cycle
videos.descripcion: Illustrates the phases of the water cycle: evaporation, condensation, and precipitation.

videos.title: The water cycle | Chameleon
videos.descripcion: An animated, fun explanation of the water cycle.

questions.q: What is it called when water turns into vapor?
questions.explanation: Evaporation is the change from liquid to gas due to solar heat.

questions.q: Where does rain mainly form?
questions.explanation: Rain forms in clouds through condensation of vapor.

questions.q: What mainly drives the water cycle?
questions.explanation: The Sun provides the energy that drives the water cycle.

videos.title: Bones for children | The skeletal system
videos.descripcion: Focuses on the skeletal system and the importance of bones.

videos.title: THE LOCOMOTOR SYSTEM
videos.descripcion: A brief introduction to the locomotor system.

videos.title: Human body: bones and muscles
videos.descripcion: Explores the locomotor system, explaining the function of bones and muscles.

questions.q: Approximately how many bones does an adult have?
questions.explanation: An adult has approximately 206 bones in their skeleton.

questions.q: What is the main function of muscles?
questions.explanation: Muscles contract to produce body movement.

questions.q: What is the longest bone in the body called?
questions.explanation: The femur (thigh bone) is the longest in the human body.

videos.title: PURE SUBSTANCES and HOMOGENEOUS and HETEROGENEOUS MIXTURES
videos.descripcion: Defines and differentiates pure substances and homogeneous and heterogeneous mixtures.

videos.title: Pure substances and mixtures
videos.descripcion: Differentiates between pure substances and mixtures, and shows separation methods.

videos.title: MIXTURES AND SEPARATIONS
videos.descripcion: Explains types of mixtures and how their components can be separated.

questions.q: Which is an example of a homogeneous mixture?
questions.explanation: Salt water is homogeneous because the salt dissolves completely.

questions.q: How can salt be separated from water?
questions.explanation: When the water evaporates, the salt remains as a solid residue.

questions.q: What is a pure substance?
questions.explanation: A pure substance contains a single type of matter.
